Under RD-5 that is agreement to a named road tied to this segment, so the whole segment - including the roads before and after Cavenagh - is exempt (RD-3). The 13:52 Orchard Road accident and band-1 congestion [F17][F14] are RD-4 matters only; they record no violation for this segment but do not change the amount.

Segment F5 (14:17-14:29, +2.87 km) [F5] counts. The rider's only route words were 'Sure' to Cavenagh and 'Can you stop at a 7-Eleven on the way?' The 0.95 km between the 5.67 km billed and the 4.72 km of measured off-route segments [F4][F5] is map-matching/rounding noise and is not refunded (RD-1). No surge is involved (1.0x) [F7][F8].

The record is complete (GPS track, all three messages timestamped [F12], full fare and traffic data), so evidence is sufficient.

The 4 min 10 s stop at 14:20–14:24 was a stationary period 2,995 m from pickup and 2,098 m from drop-off, i.e. a stop the driver chose on Beach Road (F2, F5, F13); a rider who asked only for "a 7-Eleven on the way" did not name that place, so segment 14:17–14:29 is not exempt under RD-3.

The refund is quantified by the fare record: 4.72 refundable km × $1.4100/km = $6.66, which is within the $7.99 excess distance billed on 5.67 km (F6).
